races.paceDynamic: Simon Pierre and Simba's Pride will contest the early lead in this small field, with both having prominent tendencies that should create a genuine pace through the early stages. The sustained tempo will stretch the field, putting pressure on the many hold-up horses including Clonquest, My Ballyquinn, Mayflower Billy and Raja Charger who must find significant improvement. Arc At Her's running style remains unclear but her high official rating suggests class that could override tactical disadvantages. This race shape strongly favours the early pace-setters who can avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably arise when multiple hold-up horses attempt to make their moves simultaneously in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Holds Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Simon Pierre or Simba's Pride can sustain their early advantage without folding
scenarios.body: The leaders capitalize on their tactical advantage while the hold-up brigade struggle to make up ground on good going that won't provide significant kickback. Traffic issues compound the problems for those coming from behind as multiple horses converge late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Rises Late
scenarios.trigger: If Arc At Her shows the quality her OR=120 suggests despite style concerns
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced filly demonstrates superior ability to overcome tactical disadvantages, with Clonquest also benefiting from his proven form. The early pace becomes unsustainable allowing these better-rated horses to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse Forward
scenarios.trigger: If both prominent runners fold badly in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The early pace proves too strong and both Simon Pierre and Simba's Pride fade dramatically, opening the door for the best of the hold-up horses. Clonquest's recent second at 7f suggests he has the most improvement in him.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock From Rear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unfancied hold-up horses produces significant improvement
scenarios.body: A dramatic step forward from the lower-rated closers catches the field napping, with perfect positioning proving more valuable than recent form. The pace collapses and allows a surprise package to emerge.

scenarios.body: The front-runner capitalizes on soft fractions and kicks clear in the final furlong. Prominent runners battle for the places behind the wire-to-wire winner.

races.paceDynamic: Pol Roger and Travis are the only confirmed front runners and will contest the early lead, setting up an honest gallop from the start. With 11 hold-up horses packed behind them, the pace battle between these two leaders should create a strong end-to-end gallop that will stretch the field. The large contingent of hold-up horses will be relying on these pace-setters to soften each other up through the middle sections. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up horses who can benefit from the expected strong pace and time their runs from off the speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Pol Roger and Travis engage in a genuine pace battle through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses to unleash late runs, with the pace-setters weakening in the final furlong. The sheer weight of numbers behind (11 closers) means several will get competitive runs at tired leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates Early
scenarios.trigger: If either Pol Roger or Travis establishes an uncontested lead while the other settles
scenarios.body: The lone leader gets an easier time of things and can dictate fractions, making it harder for the closers to peg back a horse with energy reserves. Travis looks the more likely to profit given his recent form edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Develops
scenarios.trigger: If both Pol Roger and Travis are restrained early, creating a slow-run race
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace will turn this into a sprint finish where horses with natural speed have the advantage over pure stayers. Those held up may find themselves too far back when the race develops quickly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Mid-Race
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders go too fast early and both crack dramatically before the turn
scenarios.body: The field will concertina together with no clear pace reference, creating a messy finish where position and luck become crucial factors. Mid-division runners may benefit from avoiding the early pace battle entirely.
